A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an efficient algorithm for best subset selection that can handle large datasets, and is able to provably solve to optimality and provide guarantees on the quality of the solution even if it is terminated early.

we have developed an algorithm that can find provably optimal solutions to the best subset selection problem in minutes for datasets that are large enough to be of practical interest, and that our algorithm is superior to other popularly used methods in terms of achieving sparsity and good predictive performance.

we have developed a MIO approach to best subset selection in regression that (1) can provably find optimal solutions in minutes for n in the thousands and p in the hundreds (2) can provably achieve near-optimal solutions in minutes for problems with n in hundreds and p in the thousands and (3) outperforms other popularly used methods in terms of achieving good sparse models with good predictive power.
